title: 第11章 挖矿第12章 摊牌了咱不装了
content_zh:
看了一眼大坑，再看看全身缠满绷带的自己，陆宸从石珠中拿出洗劫来的衣服，一下往身上裹了两套。
在把自己包得严严实实后，陆宸施展凌霄步下深坑，几个跳跃后，陆宸来到深坑的最底部。
这里恶臭一片，可通过魂力，陆宸发现下面的土属性灵气更浓郁了，已经超过了天元城任何一个地方。
带着激动的心情，陆宸捡起垃圾堆里一件废弃的兵器，然后对着侧面的洞体疯狂挖了起来。
往后一个小时，在灵力的加持下，陆宸向侧面挖出了两米，又向下挖了五米，土属性灵气直接翻倍了。
陆宸很高兴，接着向下挖洞，并且将挖出的土全部送进石珠世界，减少了一道将土搬出外面的工序。
时间缓慢流逝。
经过三个小时的努力，陆宸又向下挖了小三十米，之后，一股土属性灵气喷涌而出，陆宸终于挖到了矿。
此时，雾化的土属性灵气朝着陆宸的脸喷来，放眼望去，眼前全是黄灿灿的土属性灵晶。
“发了，有了这个土属性矿脉，武宗之前都不用愁没有灵晶修炼了。”陆宸大笑道。
高兴之余，陆宸一边对着土属性矿脉一顿乱砸，一边将挖出来的灵晶疯狂往石珠世界扔。
不知不觉间，天边已经泛出一丝光亮。
此时，忙活了一夜的陆宸已经挖到了上万块的土属性灵晶，石珠世界的灵晶都堆成了小山。
而在挖到灵晶的同时，矿脉也被陆宸挖出了一个大洞，越往深了挖，里面的灵晶品质越好。
走出洞外看了一眼天色，陆宸决定暂时不挖灵晶了，看着从大坑中喷出，几乎雾化的灵气，他皱起了眉头。
灵气这么浓郁，如果不加以处理，很快矿脉就会被人发现。
为了矿脉不被发现，陆宸将之前送进石珠世界的土全部填回了深坑里，又从后山别的地方挖了一堆土填进去。
在将土一直填到垃圾口后，陆宸又把填上的土压严实了，直到这时，那些外泄的灵气才减少了很多。
不过，即便这样，深坑周围的土属性灵气依旧比天元城其它地方高很多，至少有一点五倍。
陆宸依旧有些担心矿脉会被人发现，可是眼见天就要亮了，他只能不去想这个事，脱下脏衣服快速回了房间。

回到房间后，陆宸仔细整理了一下身上的绷带，在确定不会被人看出异常后，他睡了起来。
白天，送走像往日一样前来看自己和送饭菜的陆战、陆狂、陆毅三人后，陆宸进入了石珠世界。
折腾了一晚，他先是在石珠世界睡了几个小时，睡醒以后便拿起灵晶运转阴阳典修炼了起来。
不久后，修炼中的陆宸体内释放出一股气息，带动了周围灵气的一丝波动，顺势将阳丹突破到了七重武徒境。
武道突破七重武徒境，陆宸又继续拿着灵晶修行。
到了晚上，陆宸在众人睡下后来到了后山深坑，看着没有被人动过的深坑，陆宸松了一口气。
转念一想，陆宸又明白了。
陆家最巅峰的时候，陆家每天都会往深坑倒一次垃圾，如今陆家的人一天比一天少，只剩下五十七人，今天估计是没倒垃圾。
而且，负责倒垃圾的绝大部分都是一些无法修行的下人，一点五倍的灵气变化也很难引起他们的注意。
陆宸在庆幸陆家衰败的同时换上了脏衣服，然后不浪费一点时间，跳下深坑就动手挖出之前填的土。
因为挖过的土是松的，原本要四个小时才能挖通的入口一个小时就挖通了，之后，陆宸再次挖起了矿。
一夜时间，陆宸从矿脉中挖出了五万多块灵晶，天亮之际，陆宸再次填土，然后回房间装死。
此后的一周，陆宸每天都在重复着晚上挖矿，白天睡觉和修炼的节奏，过得很自在。
一周时间，陆宸双丹武道一起突破到了一重武士境，丹田中的灵气也在突破武士境后变成了灵液。
此外，陆宸利用这七个晚上从矿脉中挖出了五十多万的土属性灵晶，矿脉内部也出现了一个巨大的空间。
另一边
当陆宸忙得不亦乐乎时，依附陆家的人跑得只剩二十九人，那些跑掉的人转头就投奔到了其它三大家族。
由于陆宸没有再洗劫商铺，天元城恢复了往日的平静，城主府的人因为一直抓不到凶手也是直接放弃了。
content_en:
After looking at the big pit and then at himself, who was covered in bandages, Lu Chen took out the looted clothes from the stone beads and wrapped them twice in one go.
After wrapping himself tightly, Lu Chen used Ling Xiao Step to descend into the pit. After a few jumps, Lu Chen reached the bottom of the pit.
There was a stench here, but through his soul power, Lu Chen found that the earth-attribute aura below was even richer, surpassing any other place in Tianyuan City.
With excitement, Lu Chen picked up an abandoned weapon from the garbage pile, and then started digging frantically at the hole on the side.
An hour later, with the blessing of spiritual power, Lu Chen dug two meters sideways and five meters downwards, and the earth attribute spiritual energy doubled.
Lu Chen was very happy, and then dug the hole downwards and sent all the excavated soil into the Stone Bead World, which reduced the process of moving the soil out.
Time passes slowly.
After three hours of hard work, Lu Chen dug down another thirty meters. After that, a burst of earth-attribute spiritual energy spurted out, and Lu Chen finally dug the mine.
At this time, atomized earth-attribute spiritual energy sprayed towards Lu Chen's face. Looking around, he saw that all his eyes were filled with yellow earth-attribute spiritual crystals.
"Well, with this earth attribute mineral vein, Wu Zong didn't have to worry about not having spiritual crystals to practice before." Lu Chen laughed.
When he was happy, Lu Chen smashed the earth mineral veins and threw the dug spiritual crystals into the world of stone beads.
Unknowingly, there was a glimmer of light in the sky.
At this time, Lu Chen, who had been busy all night, had dug tens of thousands of earth-attribute spiritual crystals, and the spiritual crystals in the Shizhu World were piled into a hill.
While digging for the spiritual crystals, Lu Chen also dug out a large hole in the vein. The deeper he dug, the better the quality of the spiritual crystals inside.
After walking out of the cave and taking a look at the sky, Lu Chen decided not to dig for spiritual crystals for the time being. He frowned as he looked at the almost atomized spiritual energy spurting out of the pit.
The spiritual energy is so strong that if it is not treated, the veins will be discovered soon.
In order to prevent the mineral veins from being discovered, Lu Chen filled all the soil that had been sent into the Shizhu World back into the deep pit, and dug a pile of soil from other places in the back mountain to fill it in.
After filling the soil up to the garbage port, Lu Chen pressed the filled soil tightly. It was only then that the leaked spiritual energy was reduced a lot.
However, even so, the earth-attribute spiritual energy around the pit is still much higher than that in other parts of Tianyuan City, at least 1.5 times.
Lu Chen was still a little worried that the mineral vein would be discovered, but seeing that it was almost dawn, he could only not think about it, took off his dirty clothes and quickly returned to the room.
After returning to the room, Lu Chen carefully arranged the bandages on his body. After making sure that no one would notice anything unusual, he fell asleep.
During the day, after sending away Lu Zhan, Lu Kuang, and Lu Yi, who came to see him and deliver food as usual, Lu Chen entered the world of stone beads.
After struggling all night, he first slept for a few hours in the world of stone beads. After waking up, he picked up the spiritual crystal and started practicing the Yin and Yang Code.
Not long after, Lu Chen, who was practicing, released an aura from his body, which caused a slight fluctuation in the surrounding spiritual energy, and took advantage of the situation to break through the Yang Dan to the seventh-level martial arts realm.
After breaking through to the seventh level of martial arts, Lu Chen continued to practice with the spiritual crystal.
At night, after everyone fell asleep, Lu Chen went to the deep pit in the back mountain. Looking at the untouched pit, Lu Chen breathed a sigh of relief.
After thinking about it, Lu Chen understood again.
When the Lu family was at its peak, the Lu family would empty the garbage into the pit once a day. Nowadays, the number of people in the Lu family is getting smaller and smaller every day, with only fifty-seven people left. They probably didn't take out the garbage today.
Moreover, most of the people responsible for taking out the garbage are servants who are unable to practice, and it is difficult to attract their attention even if the spiritual energy changes by 1.5 times.
Lu Chen rejoiced at the decline of the Lu family and at the same time put on his dirty clothes. Then without wasting any time, he jumped down into the pit and dug out the soil that had been filled before.
Because of diggingThe soil was loose, and the entrance that originally took four hours to be dug was dug out in one hour. After that, Lu Chen started digging again.
In one night, Lu Chen dug out more than 50,000 pieces of spiritual crystals from the veins. At dawn, Lu Chen filled in the soil again, and then went back to his room to pretend to be dead.
For the next week, Lu Chen repeated the rhythm of mining at night, sleeping and practicing during the day, and lived very comfortably.
Within a week, Lu Chen's dual alchemy martial arts broke through to the first-level warrior realm, and the spiritual energy in his dantian also turned into spiritual liquid after breaking through the warrior realm.
In addition, Lu Chen used these seven nights to dig out more than 500,000 earth-type spiritual crystals from the veins, and a huge space appeared inside the veins.
other side
When Lu Chen was extremely busy, only twenty-nine people were left who were attached to the Lu family. Those who ran away turned around and defected to the other three major families.
Since Lu Chen stopped ransacking shops, Tianyuan City returned to its former peace, and the people in the City Lord's Mansion simply gave up because they couldn't catch the murderer.
